-P INPUT DROP
-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 50000:50999 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p icmp -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p udp -m udp --dport 50000:50999 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 80,443 -m comment --comment "web server" -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-host-prohibited
